---
name: write-research-note
description: Write a concise research note from actual check evidence. Use when asked to report a reproducibility check.
---
Read the existing analysis_plan.md and actual Reproducibility Reviewer check report.
Read relevant inputs and resources; use only evidence actually available.
If execution evidence is missing, ask and report NOT RUN; never present predicted results as observed.
Propose outputs/research-note.md; check the path is absent and ask approval to create it.
If it exists, preserve it and ask for a fresh filename under outputs/; check absence again.
Report Task, Input file, Approved command, Observed exit and stdout (full), Limitations, Next action.
Keep prose about 120 words excluding stdout; no fabricated results, citations or context.
Do not edit greeting, data, fixture or configuration; do not run commands or delegate.
Save only the approved new note; never overwrite existing files.
